items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
items.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

items.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
items.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

items.headline: NVIDIA Launches Vera CPU Platform for High-Performance Computing
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the 'NVIDIA Vera CPU' rack-scale platform, its first custom data center CPU designed for high-performance scientific modeling and simulation.

items.headline: Thread AI Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
items.summary: Thread AI has been accepted into the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, providing the company with access to Azure AI models and enterprise-grade support.

items.headline: Microsoft Addresses Recent 365 Service Disruption
items.summary: Microsoft has implemented new service health check methods and automated recovery systems following a global disruption to its 365 services that occurred between November 12 and 14, 2026.

items.headline: TD Cowen Adjusts Broadcom Price Target to $425 From $475
items.summary: TD Cowen has revised its price target for Broadcom Inc. to $425, down from the previous target of $475.

items.headline: Corvex Signs $103 Million Agreement for NVIDIA Blackwell Capacity
items.summary: AI cloud computing firm Corvex has entered into a $103 million take-or-pay agreement to secure NVIDIA Blackwell GPU capacity.

items.headline: BTIG Maintains Buy Rating on SBC Medical Group
items.summary: BTIG has reaffirmed its 'Buy' rating for SBC Medical Group Holdings Inc.

items.headline: TNL Mediagene's Premium Newsletter TNL Daily Completes Launch Campaign
items.summary: TNL Mediagene announced that its flagship brand, The News Lens, successfully concluded a crowdfunding campaign for its premium daily newsletter, TNL Daily, raising NT$1.39 million.

items.headline: Thiel Macro LLC Increases Stake in Vista Energy
items.summary: Thiel Macro LLC has reported an increase in its shareholding position in Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V.

items.headline: TOYO Co., Ltd Announces Unaudited Third Quarter and First Nine Months 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: TOYO Co., Ltd reported its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, noting a decline in net income and revenue compared to the previous year, alongside updates on its U.S. solar module supply

items.headline: Roze AI's Wireless IoT Fire Alarm and AI Fire Forecasting Technology Certified by Korea Airports Corporation
items.summary: Roze AI Inc. announced that its subsidiary, Roze AI Korea Co., Ltd., has received technology certification from the Korea Airports Corporation under the Korea Tech Market program.

items.headline: Verizon Overhauls Marketing Strategy to Increase Celebrity Focus
items.summary: Verizon has implemented a significant shift in its marketing approach, placing a greater emphasis on celebrity partnerships.

items.headline: Dell Technologies Joins American Sovereign SI Stack Consortium
items.summary: Dell Technologies is part of the American Sovereign SI Stack, a consortium named a priority team leader in the U.S. Department of Commerce's American SI Exports Program.

items.headline: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Strategic Updates
items.summary: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, while confirming its exit from software development services.

items.headline: Citi Markets to Donate $6.75 Million to Education-Focused Non-Profit Organizations
items.summary: Citi Markets announced a $6.75 million donation to support education-focused non-profit organizations.

items.headline: U.S. Energy Department Offers $26.54 Billion Loan to Southern Company Subsidiaries
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy has offered a $26.54 billion loan to subsidiaries of Southern Company to support grid reliability and energy infrastructure projects.

items.headline: Scotiabank Co-Leads Manulife Financial Corporation $750 Million Debenture Offering
items.summary: Scotiabank is acting as a co-lead underwriter for Manulife Financial Corporation's issuance of $750 million in subordinated debentures.

items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway Trims Stake in Capital One Financial
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway reduced its investment in Capital One Financial by approximately 62% during the third quarter of 2026, according to a regulatory filing.

items.headline: Coca-Cola Officer Executes Stock Sale
items.summary: Monica Howard-Douglas, an officer at The Coca-Cola Company, sold 9,064 shares of common stock on November 16, 2026.

items.headline: Infleqtion Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Infleqtion, Inc. reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results, showing revenue of $9.1 million and a loss of $0.09 per share.

items.headline: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight Rating and Adjusts Price Target for COPT Defense Properties
items.summary: Wells Fargo has maintained its 'Overweight' rating on COPT Defense Properties while adjusting the company's price target to $36.00 per share.

items.headline: Artemis Gold to Issue Remaining Shares Under Participation Agreement
items.summary: Artemis Gold Inc. announced it will issue 500,000 common shares to the Ulkatcho First Nation to fulfill its final obligations under a 2019 participation agreement.

items.headline: Teradyne to Present at 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference
items.summary: Teradyne, Inc. announced it will participate in the upcoming 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference.

items.headline: CenterPoint Energy Price Target Reduced by Evercore ISI Group
items.summary: Evercore ISI Group has lowered its price target for CenterPoint Energy, Inc. from $43.00 to $41.00 per share.

items.headline: Everus Construction Plans New $100 Million Share Repurchase Program
items.summary: Everus Construction Group, Inc. has announced a new share repurchase program valued at $100 million.

items.headline: Consumers Energy Appoints Brian Lewis as Vice President of Transformation
items.summary: Consumers Energy, a subsidiary of CMS Energy, has named Brian Lewis as its new vice president of transformation, effective November 16, 2026.

items.headline: J.B. Hunt Co-Designs AI-Powered Invoice Validation Platform 'Groundtruth'
items.summary: J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. collaborated with startup Groundtruth to launch an AI-driven platform designed to automate and validate freight billing information.

items.headline: SiteOne Landscape Supply to Join S&P SmallCap 600
items.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that SiteOne Landscape Supply, Inc. will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 index.

items.headline: Installed Building Products Announces Acquisition of Take Pride Insulation
items.summary: Installed Building Products, Inc. has acquired Take Pride Insulation, LLC, a Montana-based installer of spray foam, fiberglass, and rockwool insulation.

items.headline: HSBC Adjusts Evergy Price Target to $96.50 From $92
items.summary: HSBC has updated its price target for Evergy, Inc., increasing it from $92.00 to $96.50.

items.headline: Powell Industries Reports Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results
items.summary: Powell Industries announced strong fiscal 2026 results, featuring a 33% increase in fourth-quarter revenue and a record full-year backlog of $2.7 billion.
